annotations.title: Chile interest rate cap (tasa máxima convencional)

description: Get the CMF's interés corriente and interés máximo convencional in force in Chile on a date (since mid-2019), for every operation type or one code, with the validity window and the official certificate. Use cl_deuda to apply them to a debt between two dates. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/tasa-maxima via x402.

codigo.description: Operation type code from the certificate, e.g. 1.a (non-indexed peso loans under 90 days up to 5,000 UF) or 3.a (indexed, under 1 year). Omit for all.

fecha.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD, not after today; default today.
